Name: Haley's Bakery
Author: kabulla
Description:
[b][u][b][u][size=4]Compatible with stardew valley 1.6 (does not require Platonymous.Toolkit anymore)[/size]
[/u][/b]

[size=5]About the mod[/size]
[/u][/b]
[size=4]Complex and immersive personalities of the NPCs are one of the things that makes Stardew Valley so endearing to us![/size]

[size=4]Haley is, at first, a shallow and annoying cute girl; she doesn't seem suited to living in a small town like Pelican Town. But if you get to know her better, she opens up and her character develops beautifully![/size]

[size=4]Unlike most of the NPCs, she doesn't have a job, making her post-wedding routine a bit uneventful. So I thought making her a bakery owner might be a good idea, since she likes cooking and cakes. [/size]

[size=4]The bakery will start to be created in a cutscene that is triggered after Haley's 14 hearts event, in the farmhouse.
[/size]
[size=4]This will change her daily routine, some dialogues and will create a good spot to buy gifts and energy sources. Prices are a little above the market, but with such a beautiful attendant, it's worth the visit![/size]



[size=5][b][u]Events/Schedules changes[/u][/b]

[/size][spoiler][size=4]
The first event should trigger when you enter the farmhouse between 6AM to 10PM. You must have seen Haley's 14-heart event.

The next event should trigger 2 days after that, if you agree with bakery construction of course, but it mustn't be raining nor be a festival day.

After that, Haley will go to work every Tuesdays to Fridays, except festival, resort days or rainy days. 

Mr. Lewis will visit the bakery every day 19.
[/size][/spoiler]
